title: GeminiStructuredExplanation
description: Standard JSON Schema for structured AI explanations generated by Google Gemini

summary.description: High-level summary of the solution and core mathematical/scientific principles

steps.description: Sequential step-by-step breakdown of the explanation

formula.description: Optional mathematical formula or equation formatted in KaTeX/LaTeX

finalAnswer.description: Definitive final answer or conclusion to the student prompt

keyTakeaways.description: Bullet-point conceptual takeaways to reinforce learning

alternativeExplanation.description: Alternative pedagogical angle or intuitive analogy (FR-05)
